This sorghum plot is small, only a small piece of my land near the house. I keep cattle, so I spread manure on it before the rains come — that is what my family has always done. I buy a little DAP and urea from the cooperative when I can, but not much, because the price is high and the plot is small. I plant the sorghum seed I saved from last year, it grows well here and the birds and striga are the bigger worry than anything else. My wife and I and the older children do most of the work ourselves; for this small plot I don't need to hire anyone.
